title: El Farol Bar Problem
rules: You and 99 other agents must simultaneously decide whether to Go to the Bar or Stay Home. The bar has a strict capacity limit. If you go to the bar and 60 or fewer total people go, you get a high reward (10 points). If you go and more than 60 people go, the bar is overcrowded and you get a low reward (0 points). If you stay home, you get a guaranteed moderate reward (5 points). Action_A represents Going to the Bar. Action_B represents Staying Home.
